title: Report
description: How one procedure went for someone who did it, sent to the reports backend. Kept private: only aggregates and rewritten tips are ever published. The month, not the day, keeps a report less identifying.

procedure.description: id of a procedure in procedures.json

source.description: web: the form on the site; agent: an assistant reporting a pratica it ran, with the user's consent

done.description: The month the procedure ended or was last worked on, YYYY-MM

channel.description: How it was done, as the procedure's channel types

office.description: Which office or portal: one of the procedure's channel names, or altro

outcome.description: completata: done; chiesto_altro: the ente asked for more; respinta: refused; in_attesa: still waiting; rinunciato: gave up

days_to_answer.description: Days from sending the request to the ente's answer

documents.description: The procedure's listed documents, each with whether it was asked for

extra_documents.description: Documents asked for that the procedure doesn't list

claim_feedback.description: What the person found about a section of the procedure page

section.description: id of a section of the procedure, e.g. deadline or documents

verdict.description: sbagliata: wrong; superata: was true but no longer; confermata: matched what happened

consent_contact.description: The person agrees to be written to about this report

contact_email.description: Stored apart from the report and deleted after 12 months
